CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA_PRO: PII audit follow-up: CarePyre contact form moved here from plain IDUNA, gated by new contacts.manage permission (Top Admin only); 90-day post-resolution retention purge job (cmd/carepyre-contact-purge + systemd timer); local-auth and Google-auth event log entries no longer carry plaintext email, local_uid/sub only; var/*.db file permissions fixed to 640 + UMask=0027 on the service unit (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
